summary: The env lookup reads environment variables on the controller at invocation time; passing Undefined as default forces an undefined error.
questions: How do I read an environment variable in a playbook?
Does the env lookup read variables from the remote host?
How do I fail if an environment variable is missing?

answer_card.title: env lookup
answer_card.answer_md: `lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'HOME')` reads environment variables from the **controller** as they were when Ansible was invoked (not the managed host). Pass an `Undefined` object as `default` to force an undefined error.
